actions.reason: In BasicTokenizer.train, the merge pass now skips allocating and appending an output list until the selected pair is first encountered. The unchanged prefix is copied once with a slice, then the remainder is scanned as before, preserving merge order and output while reducing Python-level append work for prefixes before the first replacement.

candidate.patch:
diff --git a/minbpe/basic.py b/minbpe/basic.py
--- a/minbpe/basic.py
+++ b/minbpe/basic.py
@@ -39,19 +39,25 @@ class BasicTokenizer(Tokenizer):
             # mint a new token: assign it the next available id
             idx = 256 + i
             # replace all occurrences of pair in ids with idx
-            newids = []
-            append = newids.append
             p0, p1 = pair
             j = 0
             n = len(ids)
             while j < n:
                 if ids[j] == p0 and j < n - 1 and ids[j+1] == p1:
+                    newids = ids[:j]
+                    append = newids.append
                     append(idx)
                     j += 2
-                else:
-                    append(ids[j])
-                    j += 1
-            ids = newids
+                    while j < n:
+                        if ids[j] == p0 and j < n - 1 and ids[j+1] == p1:
+                            append(idx)
+                            j += 2
+                        else:
+                            append(ids[j])
+                            j += 1
+                    ids = newids
+                    break
+                j += 1
             # save the merge
             merges[pair] = idx
             vocab[idx] = vocab[pair[0]] + vocab[pair[1]]
